<task_context>
  <project name="echo-saas-starter" />
  <scope>
    Build a complete, modular, plugin-based SaaS starter kit.
    Backend: Go + Echo + go:embed (single binary deployment).
    Frontend: React 19 + TanStack Router (file-based routing) + shadcn/ui + Tailwind CSS.
    Database: PostgreSQL (primary) + SQLite3 WAL mode (configurable via DATABASE_URL).
    Auth: PASETO v4 local tokens.
    All features are independent plugins — each can be added or removed without breaking the core system.
    This is a reusable TEMPLATE/STARTER KIT, not a one-off product.
  </scope>
  <execution_mode>autonomous</execution_mode>
  <stack>
    <backend language="Go" framework="Echo v4" embed="go:embed" />
    <frontend framework="React 19" router="TanStack Router" routing="file-based" ui="shadcn/ui" styling="Tailwind CSS" bundler="Vite" language="TypeScript" />
    <database primary="PostgreSQL" secondary="SQLite3 WAL mode" driver_detection="auto-detect from DATABASE_URL scheme" />
    <auth mechanism="PASETO v4 local" password_hash="argon2id" token_pair="access (15min) + refresh (7d)" />
    <testing backend="go test ./..." frontend="vitest" />
  </stack>
  <infrastructure>
    <note>This is a TEMPLATE/STARTER KIT. The plugin architecture must make it trivial to add or remove any feature domain independently. Each plugin lives in its own directory under internal/plugins/ (backend) and ui/src/plugins/ (frontend), with its own routes, models, migrations, and components.</note>
    <note>Plugin removal must require ONLY: (1) delete the plugin directory, (2) remove its registration from the plugin registry. No other files should need modification.</note>
  </infrastructure>
  <domains>
    <domain name="core" description="Plugin interface, plugin manager/lifecycle, middleware chain, config loading (env + yaml), DB abstraction interface, Echo server bootstrap, error handling" />
    <domain name="database" description="Dual DB: PostgreSQL via pgx + SQLite3 via modernc.org/sqlite (pure Go). Auto-detect from DATABASE_URL scheme. Abstract DB interface. Per-plugin migrations with go:embed." />
    <domain name="auth" description="PASETO v4 local auth: access+refresh token pair, register/login/logout/refresh endpoints, token rotation, auth middleware, argon2id password hashing" />
    <domain name="roles" description="Predefined RBAC: Super Admin, Admin, User. Seed on first run. Role assignment, RequireRole middleware, guard admin routes" />
    <domain name="users" description="User CRUD (admin), self-profile (user), avatar upload, search/filter/pagination, last-seen, soft delete" />
    <domain name="plans" description="Subscription tiers: Free/Pro/Enterprise. Plan CRUD (admin), plan assignment, RequirePlan middleware for feature gating" />
    <domain name="docs" description="Headless CMS: markdown content CRUD, draft/publish, categories/tags, public rendering with syntax highlighting, search" />
    <domain name="guest" description="Public pages: landing (hero+features+CTA), pricing comparison, docs listing + detail, register, login. All without auth." />
    <domain name="admin-dashboard" description="Admin panel: overview stats, user/role/plan/content management pages. Protected by RequireRole Admin." />
    <domain name="user-dashboard" description="User panel: profile, subscription status, usage overview, settings. Protected by RequireRole User." />
  </domains>
</task_context>

<task_definitions>

  <task id="1" domain="core + foundation">
    <objective>
      Set up the complete project foundation: Go backend with Echo, plugin system architecture,
      configuration management, database abstraction, middleware chain, go:embed for SPA,
      and frontend project initialization with TanStack Router + shadcn/ui + Tailwind.
    </objective>
    <steps>
      <step>Initialize Go module: go mod init echo-saas-starter. Add dependencies: echo v4, pgx, modernc.org/sqlite, paseto v4, argon2, viper or envconfig for config, golang-migrate for migrations.</step>
      <step>Create the plugin interface (internal/core/plugin.go) that every feature plugin must implement. Include: Name(), Version(), Init(config, db), RegisterRoutes(*echo.Group), Migrate(db), Shutdown(). Support optional hooks: OnStartup, OnMiddleware.</step>
      <step>Create the plugin manager (internal/core/manager.go) that handles plugin lifecycle: registration, initialization order, route mounting, migration execution, shutdown sequence.</step>
      <step>Create configuration system (internal/config/config.go): load from env vars + optional config.yaml. Required: DATABASE_URL, PASETO_SECRET, SERVER_PORT, SERVER_HOST. Optional: LOG_LEVEL, CORS_ORIGINS.</step>
      <step>Create database abstraction layer (internal/core/database.go): define DB interface with common methods (Exec, Query, QueryRow, Migrate, Close). Implement PostgreSQL driver (internal/database/postgres.go) and SQLite3 WAL driver (internal/database/sqlite.go). Auto-detect from DATABASE_URL scheme.</step>
      <step>Create middleware chain (internal/core/middleware.go): CORS, request logging, panic recovery, request ID generation. All middleware must be configurable via config.</step>
      <step>Create Echo server bootstrap (internal/server/server.go): initialize Echo, apply middleware, mount plugin routes under /api/v1 prefix, serve embedded SPA for all non-API routes.</step>
      <step>Set up go:embed in a dedicated file (internal/embed/embed.go): embed ui/dist/ directory. Create http.FileSystem wrapper for SPA fallback routing.</step>
      <step>Create main.go (cmd/server/main.go): load config, initialize DB, create plugin manager, register all plugins, run migrations, start server.</step>
      <step>Create plugin registry (internal/plugins/registry.go): import and register all plugin constructors. This is the ONLY file that references specific plugins.</step>
      <step>Initialize frontend project (ui/): Create React + TypeScript + Vite project. Add TanStack Router with file-based routing. Add shadcn/ui. Configure Tailwind CSS. Set up directory structure: routes/, components/ui/, lib/, hooks/, stores/, plugins/.</step>
      <step>Create frontend API client (ui/src/lib/api.ts): base HTTP client with PASETO token handling, automatic refresh, error interception. All plugin API calls go through this client.</step>
      <step>Create .env.example with DATABASE_URL examples for both PostgreSQL and SQLite3.</step>
      <step>Create Makefile with targets: build, run, test, dev, migrate, seed, lint, clean.</step>
    </steps>
  </task>

  <task id="2" domain="auth + roles">
    <objective>
      Implement the authentication and authorization plugins: PASETO-based auth with access/refresh
      token pair, and predefined RBAC with Super Admin, Admin, User roles.
    </objective>
    <sub_task id="2.1" name="Auth Plugin (PASETO)">
      <context>
        Use PASETO v4 local (symmetric) tokens. Access token: 15-minute expiry.
        Refresh token: 7-day expiry, stored in DB, rotated on each refresh.
        Password hashing: argon2id with configurable parameters.
        PASETO secret key: generated on first run and stored in config/secrets.
      </context>
      <requirements>
        <requirement>Implement plugin interface: internal/plugins/auth/plugin.go</requirement>
        <requirement>Models (internal/plugins/auth/models.go): User struct (id, email, password_hash, name, avatar, created_at, updated_at, last_seen_at, is_active), RefreshToken struct (id, user_id, token, expires_at, created_at)</requirement>
        <requirement>Repository (internal/plugins/auth/repository.go): database operations for user CRUD and refresh token management</requirement>
        <requirement>Handlers (internal/plugins/auth/handlers.go): POST /auth/register, POST /auth/login, POST /auth/logout, POST /auth/refresh, GET /auth/me</requirement>
        <requirement>Middleware (internal/plugins/auth/middleware.go): RequireAuth — extract PASETO access token from Authorization header, validate, inject user into echo.Context</requirement>
        <requirement>Migrations: users table, refresh_tokens table. Must be compatible with both PostgreSQL and SQLite3.</requirement>
        <requirement>Error responses must follow consistent format: {"error": {"code": "AUTH_001", "message": "..."}}</requirement>
        <requirement>Frontend: auth context/store (ui/src/plugins/auth/store.ts), API functions (ui/src/plugins/auth/api.ts), login page (ui/src/routes/_guest/login.tsx), register page (ui/src/routes/_guest/register.tsx)</requirement>
        <requirement>Auth context must handle: token storage (localStorage), automatic refresh on expiry, logout cleanup, user state management</requirement>
      </requirements>
    </sub_task>
    <sub_task id="2.2" name="Roles Plugin (RBAC)">
      <context>
        Predefined roles: Super Admin (id=1), Admin (id=2), User (id=3).
        Roles are seeded during initial migration — no manual setup needed.
        Super Admin has unrestricted access to everything.
        Admin can manage users, plans, content — but not other admins or system settings.
        User can only access their own dashboard and profile.
      </context>
      <requirements>
        <requirement>Implement plugin interface: internal/plugins/roles/plugin.go</requirement>
        <requirement>Models: Role struct (id, name, description, created_at), UserRole struct (user_id, role_id, assigned_at)</requirement>
        <requirement>Repository: role CRUD, user-role assignment queries</requirement>
        <requirement>Handlers: GET /roles (list), POST /roles/:id/assign (assign role to user — admin only), GET /users/:id/roles (get user's roles)</requirement>
        <requirement>Middleware (internal/plugins/roles/middleware.go): RequireRole(roles ...string) — check if authenticated user has one of the specified roles. Chain with RequireAuth from auth plugin.</requirement>
        <requirement>Migrations: roles table (seeded with 3 predefined roles), user_roles table</requirement>
        <requirement>Frontend: role-based route guards (ui/src/components/auth/RequireRole.tsx), role badge component, role display in user tables</requirement>
      </requirements>
    </sub_task>
  </task>

  <task id="3" domain="users">
    <objective>
      Implement the user management plugin: admin-side CRUD with search/filter/pagination,
      and user-side profile management with avatar upload.
    </objective>
    <requirements>
      <requirement>Implement plugin interface: internal/plugins/users/plugin.go</requirement>
      <requirement>Models: UserProfile struct (user_id, bio, location, website, phone, timezone, language, notification_preferences)</requirement>
      <requirement>Repository: user CRUD, search by name/email, filter by role/status/plan, pagination, soft delete, last-seen tracking</requirement>
      <requirement>Admin handlers: GET /users (list with search, filter, pagination), GET /users/:id, POST /users, PUT /users/:id, DELETE /users/:id (soft delete)</requirement>
      <requirement>User handlers: GET /users/me, PUT /users/me, POST /users/me/avatar (upload), PUT /users/me/password (change password)</requirement>
      <requirement>Admin endpoints protected by RequireRole("super_admin", "admin"). User endpoints protected by RequireAuth.</requirement>
      <requirement>Migrations: user_profiles table (1:1 with users), avatar storage (local filesystem path)</requirement>
      <requirement>Frontend admin: user management page (ui/src/routes/_admin/users.tsx) — data table with search input, role filter dropdown, pagination, inline actions (edit, delete, view). User detail page (ui/src/routes/_admin/users.$id.tsx).</requirement>
      <requirement>Frontend user: profile page (ui/src/routes/_dashboard/profile.tsx) — form with name, bio, location, website, phone, avatar upload with preview. Settings page (ui/src/routes/_dashboard/settings.tsx) — change password form, notification preferences, account deletion with confirmation dialog.</requirement>
    </requirements>
  </task>

  <task id="4" domain="plans">
    <objective>
      Implement the subscription plans plugin: plan CRUD for admins, plan assignment,
      and feature gating middleware for plan-based access control.
    </objective>
    <requirements>
      <requirement>Implement plugin interface: internal/plugins/plans/plugin.go</requirement>
      <requirement>Models: Plan struct (id, name, slug, description, price_monthly, price_yearly, features JSON, is_active, created_at), UserPlan struct (user_id, plan_id, status, starts_at, expires_at, created_at)</requirement>
      <requirement>Repository: plan CRUD, user-plan assignment, active plan lookup</requirement>
      <requirement>Admin handlers: GET /plans (list), GET /plans/:id, POST /plans, PUT /plans/:id, DELETE /plans/:id, POST /plans/:id/assign (assign to user)</requirement>
      <requirement>User handlers: GET /plans/current (my current plan), GET /plans/available (list available plans for upgrade)</requirement>
      <requirement>Middleware (internal/plugins/plans/middleware.go): RequirePlan(slugs ...string) — check if user's active plan matches one of the specified plan slugs. Feature gating: each API endpoint can declare required plan level.</requirement>
      <requirement>Seed data: Free (price=0, features=["basic"]), Pro (price=29, features=["basic","advanced","analytics"]), Enterprise (price=99, features=["basic","advanced","analytics","priority","custom"])</requirement>
      <requirement>Migrations: plans table (seeded), user_plans table</requirement>
      <requirement>Frontend admin: plan management page (ui/src/routes/_admin/plans.tsx) — table with plan details, edit dialog, assign user dialog</requirement>
      <requirement>Frontend user: subscription page (ui/src/routes/_dashboard/subscription.tsx) — current plan display, upgrade options, plan comparison</requirement>
      <requirement>Frontend guest: pricing page (ui/src/routes/_guest/pricing.tsx) — plan comparison table with features matrix, CTA buttons for register/upgrade</requirement>
    </requirements>
  </task>

  <task id="5" domain="docs cms">
    <objective>
      Implement the docs/blog CMS plugin: markdown content management with draft/publish workflow,
      categories, tags, and public rendering with syntax highlighting.
    </objective>
    <requirements>
      <requirement>Implement plugin interface: internal/plugins/docs/plugin.go</requirement>
      <requirement>Models: Post struct (id, title, slug, content_md, content_html, excerpt, status [draft/published], category_id, author_id, published_at, created_at, updated_at), Category struct (id, name, slug, description), Tag struct (id, name, slug), PostTag struct (post_id, tag_id)</requirement>
      <requirement>Repository: post CRUD, slug-based lookup, category/tag CRUD, post-category/tag association, full-text search, pagination</requirement>
      <requirement>Admin handlers: GET /posts (list all, filter by status/category/tag), GET /posts/:id, POST /posts, PUT /posts/:id, DELETE /posts/:id, POST /posts/:id/publish, POST /posts/:id/unpublish. Category CRUD: GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /categories. Tag CRUD: GET/POST/DELETE /tags.</requirement>
      <requirement>Public handlers: GET /docs (list published), GET /docs/:slug (get by slug), GET /docs/search?q= (full-text search)</requirement>
      <requirement>Markdown rendering: use goldmark or blackfriday for MD→HTML. Add syntax highlighting extension for code blocks (chroma or similar).</requirement>
      <requirement>Migrations: posts, categories, tags, post_tags tables</requirement>
      <requirement>Frontend admin: content management page (ui/src/routes/_admin/content.tsx) — table with status filter, create/edit page with markdown editor (use @uiw/react-md-editor or similar), category/tag assignment, preview toggle</requirement>
      <requirement>Frontend guest: docs listing page (ui/src/routes/_guest/docs/index.tsx) — card grid with search, category filter. Individual doc page (ui/src/routes/_guest/docs/$slug.tsx) — rendered markdown with table of contents, syntax highlighting, share buttons</requirement>
    </requirements>
  </task>

  <task id="6" domain="guest pages">
    <objective>
      Build the public-facing guest pages: landing page, pricing page, docs listing,
      and auth pages. All accessible without authentication. Responsive and SEO-friendly.
    </objective>
    <requirements>
      <requirement>Landing page (ui/src/routes/_guest/index.tsx): hero section with headline + subheadline + CTA button, features grid (6 cards minimum with icons), testimonials section (placeholder data), footer with links. Must be fully responsive (mobile-first design).</requirement>
      <requirement>Pricing page (ui/src/routes/_guest/pricing.tsx): plan comparison table/cards fetched from /plans/available API. Show plan name, price, feature list, CTA button. Highlight recommended plan (Pro). Toggle monthly/yearly pricing if available.</requirement>
      <requirement>Docs listing (ui/src/routes/_guest/docs/index.tsx): card grid of published docs fetched from /docs API. Search input with debounced search. Category filter sidebar/dropdown. Cards show: title, excerpt, category, published date, author.</requirement>
      <requirement>Doc detail (ui/src/routes/_guest/docs/$slug.tsx): rendered markdown content with table of contents (auto-generated from headings), syntax highlighting for code blocks, share/copy link buttons, back-to-list navigation.</requirement>
      <requirement>Login page (ui/src/routes/_guest/login.tsx): email + password form, "Remember me" checkbox, "Forgot password?" link (placeholder), "Register" link. On success: redirect to appropriate dashboard based on role (admin → /admin, user → /dashboard).</requirement>
      <requirement>Register page (ui/src/routes/_guest/register.tsx): name + email + password + confirm password form. Validation (email format, password strength, password match). On success: redirect to login with success message. "Already have account?" link.</requirement>
      <requirement>Guest layout (ui/src/routes/_guest.tsx): shared layout with navbar (logo, nav links, login/register buttons or user avatar if authenticated) and footer. Navbar must be sticky with mobile hamburger menu.</requirement>
      <requirement>SEO: each page must set appropriate document.title, meta description, Open Graph tags via TanStack Router head elements or useEffect.</requirement>
      <requirement>Dark mode support: all pages must work in both light and dark mode using shadcn/ui's built-in theme system (CSS variables). Default to system preference.</requirement>
    </requirements>
  </task>

  <task id="7" domain="admin dashboard">
    <objective>
      Build the admin dashboard: overview with statistics, and management pages for users,
      roles, plans, and content. All protected by RequireRole("super_admin", "admin").
    </objective>
    <requirements>
      <requirement>Admin layout (ui/src/routes/_admin.tsx): sidebar navigation (collapsible on mobile) with links to all admin pages. Top bar with user info, role badge, logout button. Protected by RequireRole. Redirect to /login if unauthorized.</requirement>
      <requirement>Overview page (ui/src/routes/_admin/index.tsx): stats cards row (total users, active plans, published docs, recent registrations). Activity feed or recent actions list. Quick action buttons (add user, create post, manage plans). Data fetched from GET /admin/stats endpoint.</requirement>
      <requirement>User management (ui/src/routes/_admin/users.tsx): data table with columns (name, email, role, plan, status, last seen, actions). Search by name/email. Filter by role, plan, status. Pagination. Row actions: view detail, edit, delete (with confirmation), assign role, assign plan.</requirement>
      <requirement>User detail (ui/src/routes/_admin/users.$id.tsx): user profile card, role assignment dropdown, plan assignment dropdown, activity log, edit form.</requirement>
      <requirement>Role management (ui/src/routes/_admin/roles.tsx): list of roles with user count. Role detail showing assigned users. Assign/unassign users to roles.</requirement>
      <requirement>Plan management (ui/src/routes/_admin/plans.tsx): plan cards/table with name, price, features, user count. Create/edit plan dialog. Assign plan to user dialog.</requirement>
      <requirement>Content management (ui/src/routes/_admin/content.tsx): post list with status filter (all/draft/published). Create new post button linking to edit page. Edit page with markdown editor, category/tag selection, publish/unpublish toggle, preview.</requirement>
      <requirement>System settings (ui/src/routes/_admin/settings.tsx): site name, logo upload, default language, maintenance mode toggle. Save to config or database.</requirement>
      <requirement>All admin API endpoints must be protected by RequireAuth + RequireRole("super_admin", "admin") middleware chain.</requirement>
      <requirement>Responsive: sidebar collapses to hamburger on mobile. Tables become card-based on small screens.</requirement>
    </requirements>
  </task>

  <task id="8" domain="user dashboard">
    <objective>
      Build the user dashboard: profile management, subscription status, and account settings.
      All protected by RequireAuth (any authenticated user).
    </objective>
    <requirements>
      <requirement>User layout (ui/src/routes/_dashboard.tsx): top navigation or sidebar (simpler than admin). User avatar + name display. Logout button. Protected by RequireAuth. Redirect to /login if unauthorized.</requirement>
      <requirement>Overview page (ui/src/routes/_dashboard/index.tsx): welcome message with user name, subscription status card (current plan, expiry, features), quick links to profile and subscription, recent activity placeholder.</requirement>
      <requirement>Profile page (ui/src/routes/_dashboard/profile.tsx): edit form with fields (name, email [readonly], bio, location, website, phone, timezone). Avatar upload with image preview and crop. Save button with loading state. Success/error toast notifications.</requirement>
      <requirement>Subscription page (ui/src/routes/_dashboard/subscription.tsx): current plan display card with features list. "Upgrade" button if not on highest plan. Plan comparison section. Billing history placeholder (for future implementation).</requirement>
      <requirement>Settings page (ui/src/routes/_dashboard/settings.tsx): change password form (current password + new password + confirm). Notification preferences (email notifications toggle). Theme preference (light/dark/system). Delete account with confirmation dialog (type email to confirm).</requirement>
      <requirement>All pages must be responsive and work on mobile devices.</requirement>
    </requirements>
  </task>

  <task id="9" domain="integration + cross-stack verification">
    <objective>
      Verify end-to-end integration across all plugins and both stacks (Go backend + React frontend).
      Ensure API contracts are consistent, all flows work correctly, and the system is production-ready.
    </objective>
    <steps>
      <step>Verify all API endpoints exist and are correctly mounted under /api/v1/. Check route documentation or generate OpenAPI spec.</step>
      <step>Verify cross-stack contract consistency: every API response shape (field names, types, nesting) matches what the frontend expects. Check each API client function against its corresponding handler.</step>
      <step>Verify auth flow end-to-end: register → login → access protected endpoint → refresh token → logout. Test with both PostgreSQL and SQLite.</step>
      <step>Verify RBAC flow: Super Admin can access everything, Admin can manage users/plans/content, User can only access own dashboard. Test role-based access for each endpoint.</step>
      <step>Verify plan-based feature gating: RequirePlan middleware correctly blocks/allows access based on user's current plan.</step>
      <step>Verify plugin independence: delete one plugin directory and its registry entry, confirm go build and npm run build still pass without errors.</step>
      <step>Verify go:embed: build the binary, run it, confirm the SPA is served correctly from the embedded filesystem. Check that static assets load, routing works, and API calls succeed.</step>
      <step>Verify dual database: start with DATABASE_URL=sqlite://... and confirm all features work. Start with DATABASE_URL=postgres://... and confirm all features work. Run migrations on both.</step>
      <step>Verify error handling: test invalid inputs, missing auth, wrong roles, expired tokens, database errors. All should return proper error responses (not 500 stack traces).</step>
      <step>Verify responsive design: check all pages at mobile (375px), tablet (768px), and desktop (1280px) widths.</step>
    </steps>
  </task>

  <task id="10" domain="build + deploy + documentation">
    <objective>
      Create build and deployment configuration: Makefile, Dockerfile, docker-compose.yml,
      and comprehensive README.md with setup instructions and architecture documentation.
    </objective>
    <requirements>
      <requirement>Makefile targets: build (compile binary), run (build + run), test (run all tests), dev (hot reload for both backend and frontend), migrate (run database migrations), seed (seed initial data), lint (golangci-lint + eslint), clean (remove build artifacts), docker-build, docker-run</requirement>
      <requirement>Dockerfile (multi-stage): Stage 1 — build frontend (node:20-alpine, npm install, npm run build). Stage 2 — build backend (golang:1.22-alpine, copy ui/dist from stage 1, go build with embed). Stage 3 — final image (alpine:3.19, copy binary, expose port, ENTRYPOINT).</requirement>
      <requirement>docker-compose.yml: two services — app (build from Dockerfile, env_file, ports, depends_on) and postgres (postgres:16-alpine, volume for data persistence, healthcheck). Include .env file reference.</requirement>
      <requirement>.env.example: DATABASE_URL (both postgres and sqlite examples), PASETO_SECRET, SERVER_PORT, SERVER_HOST, LOG_LEVEL, CORS_ORIGINS, POSTGRES_USER, POSTGRES_PASSWORD, POSTGRES_DB.</requirement>
      <requirement>README.md: project overview, features list, quick start (3 commands: clone, docker-compose up, open browser), development setup, plugin architecture explanation (how to add/remove plugins), configuration reference, project structure tree, tech stack table, contributing guidelines.</requirement>
      <requirement>.gitignore: Go binary, node_modules, .env, dist/, build artifacts, IDE files, database files (*.db, *.sqlite).</requirement>
    </requirements>
  </task>

</task_definitions>
